profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, this German accommodation and food service provider has experienced rapid expansion, growing its workforce by 233.3% since its baseline. As a key player in the sector, its success can be attributed to its ability to adapt to evolving consumer preferences and deliver high-quality services. By focusing on innovative hospitality solutions, the company has established itself as a scaler, with 50 employees driving its growth in 2024.
